title: Paired downstream contract review of coordination and evaluation runtimes
problem: The coordination, impact, context-routing, and evaluation contracts form one consumer-facing path; a real contract reviewer should be measured with an executed no-route baseline and an intent-aware route.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: The reviewer baseline is synchronized after setup but before its verification intent, and its delivered route items are persisted exactly.
An overlapping verification intent receives a persisted ImpactDetected route without an explicit dependency edge.
The bounded route replays deterministically and an unrelated observer receives no route.
An independent reviewer workspace runs the real coordination and evaluation runtime tests and records the exact result.
A distinct remotely qualified stable predecessor controls the coordination workflow; candidate daemon authority is not used.

evidencePlan.coordination: Persist WorkItems, sessions, intents, executed baseline and intent-aware cursors, route reasons, replay keys, observer isolation, and completion events.
evidencePlan.evaluation: Record the downstream contract test outcome without manufacturing evaluator feedback or repair iterations.
evidencePlan.correctness: Bind reviewer workspace HEAD, test output, candidate SHA, predecessor SHA, and remote required check-runs.

observedEvidenceBoundary: OT-009 is a real contract review of committed my-pi runtime code. It contributes observed routing and correctness evidence, but it cannot claim a rework reduction unless downstream rework is measured against the executed baseline.
